answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 25322 Country: India Title: How to acess zakat , i am drawing gross salary 3.50 lacs per annum? Question: how to acess zakat , i am drawing gross salary 3.50 lacs per annum , Answer ID: 25322 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1871/1353/H=1431) According to the lunar calendar i.e. the date in which you became sahib-e-nisab each year on this date count whatever amount and zakah property are in your possession and deduct 2.5 % as zakah and give it to the deserving and needy people. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
